label: An accessible successor from the no-dead-end frame condition
meaning: For one frame and selected world w, if all worlds satisfy the no-dead-end condition and excluded middle holds, there exists a world accessible from w. This gives the world witness used in finite roster amalgamation without assuming that w accesses itself. The witness need not be distinct or populated. The global no-dead-end premise is incomparable with self-access at a single selected world.

strong_version_needed.ee4ab504-c8fe-59bc-bc96-7cbeefed6410: The proof applies excluded middle to propositions outside LocalLogic's scope, e.g. `TruthCore.Case.Catholicism.StageOne.NecessaryIndividual.AccessibleSuccessor F w`. LocalLogic (ca432e24) decides only whether an actual bearer is identical with a GOD_4 candidate, and gives double-negation elimination for that candidate's esse–essence identity.
